name: AI Datasets
blurb: Training and evaluation datasets with size, licence, provenance, language coverage, and documented bias.

reading.body:
The AI Datasets section currently lists no datasets at all, only three subcategories: training datasets, evaluation datasets, and dataset licensing and provenance.

The intended scope is specific: size, licence, provenance, language coverage, and documented bias for both training and evaluation data. With zero entries, none of those attributes can be examined or compared. The structure anticipates a taxonomy, not a collection.

For AI, datasets are the raw material for pre-training and the yardstick for evaluation. An empty dataset hub means no evidence here about what data is available, what may lawfully be used, or how bias is measured. It also provides no basis for linking data volume or quality to compute demand, buildings, or power.

The three child categories describe what would be covered, but no entries are present to show when or how many will appear.
